title: Discuss a failed attempt
text: What did you learn from an unsuccessful attempt?

options.text: I tried again, but I did not record what changed.
options.response: 提到了部分处理方式，但解释还不完整。

options.text: I checked the assumptions, kept the failed runs and revised the next experiment.
options.response: 回答说明了关键条件和处理方法。

options.text: I removed the failed result because it was not useful.
options.response: 这一说法忽略了关键条件，需要重新分析。
